thread:
sam: quick sync to lock the onboarding probe contract before RFC. main concern: heavy validation stealing prod capacity
ingrid: agree. propose probe tiers: smoke (sync, 5 inputs), sample (sync, configurable N), full (async, gated)
mike: headers to control: X-Probe-Tier: smoke|sample|full, X-Probe-ID (uuid), X-Samples (optional), X-Max-Tokens to bound memory
tara: routing rule: full -> onboard-slowpath (async). sample -> fastpath but rate-limited. smoke -> fastpath with priority
mike: fallback if slowpath saturated -> 202 Accepted + Retry-After + durable enqueue. caller can pass X-Async-Callback for webhook
ingrid: telemetry keys: onboard.tier, onboard.probe_id, onboard.route, onboard.goldset_hit_count. include probe id in traces
ops-bot: infra note: will create onboard-slowpath ASG (min=0,max=8) and alert on slowpath.queue_length > 50 for 5m
sam: decision: implement headers + routing + async webhook contract + 202 fallback + autoscale + telemetry. i'll open RFC with minimal curl and webhook examples and tag runtime/devx :thumbsup:
